दीवाली 2026 पर रिलीज होने वाली फिल्म Ramayana की एडवांस बुकिंग में बड़ा धमाका हुआ है! 🔥

नितेश तिवारी के निर्देशन में बनी फिल्म Ramayana 5 नवंबर को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होने जा रही है।
26 अक्टूबर दोपहर 12:30 बजे तक फिल्म ने भारत में 9.66 करोड़ रुपये ग्रॉस (8.2 करोड़ नेट) की कमाई कर ली है।
अब तक 4,663 शो के लिए 1.73 लाख से ज्यादा टिकट बिक चुके हैं और देश में 6 शो हाउसफुल हो चुके हैं।
इस एडवांस बुकिंग में बेंगलुरु ने 1.38 करोड़ रुपये का कलेक्शन करके मुंबई के 1.32 करोड़ रुपये को पीछे छोड़ दिया है।
दिल्ली में 1.9 करोड़ रुपये के साथ सबसे ज्यादा बुकिंग हुई है, जबकि अहमदाबाद में 1 और हैदराबाद में 5 हाउसफुल शो दर्ज हुए हैं। 💥

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ranbir Kapoor और Yash की यह फिल्म Box Office पर इतिहास रचेगी? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में दीजिए! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana Box Office Day 1 Advance Booking (10 Days To Go): 6 Houseful Shows Locked, Bengaluru Surpasses Mumbai In Pre-Sales For Ranbir Kapoor & Yash’s Biggie!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana is displaying a steady pace at the box office, with Hyderabad and Bengaluru displaying strength - day 1 advance booking report. 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office Day 1 Advance Booking (10 Days To Go): 6 Houseful Shows Locked, Bengaluru Surpasses Mumbai In Pre-Sales For Ranbir Kapoor & Yash’s Biggie!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The momentum surrounding Indian cinema’s most anticipated cinematic spectacle is building up a storm slowly yet steadily. With exactly 10 days remaining before its historic worldwide release on November 5 (Diwali 2026), director Nitesh Tiwari’s magnum opus Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, is showcasing strong regional trends at the advance booking counters.
As of October 26, 12:30 PM IST, the epic saga has collected 9.66 crore gross (8.2 crore net) , excluding blocked seats, selling over 1.73 lakh tickets across 4,663 tracked shows in India. In a major turn of events, Bengaluru has officially overtaken Mumbai in pre-sales revenue, driven by roaring demand for Yash and the film’s multi-language release!
Ramayana has registered 6 houseful shows in India, including 1 sold-out show in Ahmedabad. Meanwhile, 5 houseful shows are registered in Hyderabad, which include 1 in Hindi and 4 in Telugu! The pre-sales have maintained a steady upward climb as more showtimes and regional screens open up across northern and southern belts.
While Delhi-NCR retains its dominant top spot with the advance sales for the opening day hitting 1.9 crore , Bengaluru’s massive spike has allowed it to edge past Mumbai in pre-sales contribution. Mumbai has registered 1.32 crore pre-sales for the opening day, while Bengaluru stands at 1.38 crore gross pre-sales.
Standing at 9.66 crore gross with 10 full days left on the clock, Ramayana is cruising effortlessly toward the double-digit pre-sales threshold. With southern heavyweights like Bengaluru and Hyderabad demonstrating phenomenal early occupancy alongside traditional northern strongholds, Ranbir Kapoor and Yash are setting up a truly pan-Indian box office eruption for Diwali 2026!
